technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochastic reversal signal are offset by pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, below cloud); ADX confirms downtrend strength rather than reversal potential.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 56 days present material risk with insufficient smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with weak congressional activity (small trades by junior members), greed-zone market sentiment warranting caution, and unavailable news data limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (129.96) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, NFP event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 56 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme oversold (below 30) with stochastic cross-up provides classic mean-reversion setup near support at 122.36, and ADX confirms strong directional conviction that could reverse.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, below Ichimoku cloud, CMF negative, no bullish crossovers) combined with severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 129.96, inverted yield curve, strong dollar, NFP event in 1 day, earnings binary risk in 56 days) and zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no smart money accumulation) makes oversold bounce unreliable.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI 9 extreme oversold with stochastic cross-up offers classic mean-reversion setup at support, but this is negated by pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, below cloud) and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, NFP event tomorrow).
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary risk in 56 days combined with zero fundamental support (no smart money accumulation, no insider conviction) and macro recession signals make any bounce unreliable; VIX crisis at 129.96 could trigger further capitulation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical oversold conditions
